## Standard PICRUSt2 demonstration

The analysis and figures for this demonstration are being prepared.

For input formats and available functions, see the [standard PICRUSt2 workflow](standard-pipeline.html) and [Community-level visualizations](sample-level-plots.html).

## Data for this workflow

Standard PICRUSt2 output contains a function-by-sample matrix, with one predicted community-level abundance per function in each sample. Matching sample metadata identifies the groups to compare. Unlike a stratified contribution table, this input pools the ASV contributions within each sample.

This page will describe the study cohort and display the completed analyses when those results are available.
